en: Handy for everything, but in summer the walk home feels like crossing a frying pan. Not many shady places to stop.
zh: 这里去哪儿都方便，就是夏天走回家像在铁板上烤，想找个阴凉地方歇脚都难。

en: Keep a clear path towards the station, with shade and somewhere to sit while checking bus times. Please don't put stalls across the walking route.
zh: 往车站的路要留宽敞些，有遮阴，也能坐着查公交时间。摊位别挡着大家赶路就好。

en: I like the food around here. The footpaths are another story when you're pushing a pram past bins and outdoor tables.
zh: 附近吃的我挺喜欢。但推婴儿车出门就没那么轻松了，人行道上又是垃圾桶，又是餐桌。

en: Proper public toilets, please. Not a sign sending you into a cafe where you feel obliged to buy something.
zh: 请建真正的公共厕所，别立个牌子让人去咖啡店借厕所，进去还不好意思不买东西。

en: It's noisy enough at night already. I enjoy living near restaurants, just not hearing people shouting after they've shut.
zh: 现在晚上已经够吵了。住得离餐馆近是方便，但店都关了，外面还有人大喊大叫，真受不了。

en: Night markets could bring people past our shop after work. Give traders power, bins and clear loading arrangements, not just a pretty paved space.
zh: 夜市能让下班的人多来逛逛，我们店也能沾点光。但得有电源、垃圾桶，还要安排好卸货，不能光把地铺漂亮。

en: The car park isn't pretty, but I use it when carrying groceries. Getting rid of it doesn't magically make shopping easier.
zh: 停车场是不好看，可买菜拎大包小包时真用得上。拆了也不会让买东西突然变方便。

en: I'd happily lose the car park for trees and shaded seats. Just don't call a few tiny saplings a finished square.
zh: 我愿意把停车场换成树和阴凉座椅。但别插几棵小树苗，就说广场建好了。

en: Mostly it's convenient. Finding a clean toilet nearby is the annoying bit.
zh: 总体挺方便的，就是附近不好找干净的厕所，这点很烦。

en: Seats with backs and armrests would help. Leave room beside them for a wheelchair, so we're sitting together rather than blocking the path.
zh: 椅子最好有靠背和扶手，旁边也给轮椅留个位置。这样能坐在一起，不用停在路中间挡着别人。

en: Maybe I'm missing the quieter spots, but around here I usually end up buying a drink just to get a seat out of the sun.
zh: 也许是我没找到安静的角落吧，反正在这附近想躲太阳坐一会儿，最后往往还得买杯饮料。

en: Make Chinatown feel like somewhere to linger, with food stalls and small cultural events. It shouldn't just be an arch and some themed paving.
zh: 唐人街要让人愿意多待会儿，可以有小吃摊和文化活动。别弄个牌楼、铺点特色地砖就算完事。

en: The crossings feel rushed with a pram. I end up taking the long way because some kerbs are awkward.
zh: 推婴儿车过马路总觉得时间不够。有些路口上下路沿也不顺，我宁可绕远一点。

en: Please keep some nearby short stay parking. Customers collecting food won't all carry hot takeaway boxes from a distant garage, especially in the rain.
zh: 附近还是得留些临时停车位。来取餐的客人不一定愿意从老远的停车场走过来拎热饭，下雨天更麻烦。

en: I quite like the bustle near Church Street. Some corners feel gloomy after dinner though, especially once the shops start closing.
zh: 我挺喜欢Church Street附近热热闹闹的感觉。不过吃完晚饭出来，有些角落挺暗，店铺陆续关门后更明显。

en: Shade first, fancy features later. A drinking fountain would be good too.
zh: 先把遮阴做好，再考虑那些花样。能有个饮水台就更好了。

en: We come for dinner and usually leave straight afterwards. There's nowhere obvious to sit outside without ordering more food.
zh: 我们一般来吃个晚饭就走，想在外面坐坐，又不继续点东西，还真不知道去哪儿。

en: A smooth, step free route between Wentworth Street and the transport stops would help. And toilets that are open when the early buses run.
zh: 从Wentworth Street到车站和公交站，最好一路平整、没有台阶。厕所也要早点开，赶早班车的人用得上。

en: Honestly, the rubbish bothers me more than the buildings. Some mornings the takeaway packaging is everywhere. Anyway, the bakery nearby is great.
zh: 说真的，比起楼长什么样，我更在意垃圾。有些早上满地都是外卖包装。不过话说回来，附近的面包店确实不错。

en: Please no loud night market every weekend. I'd use a quiet green square in the evening, but not another amplified entertainment area.
zh: 别每个周末都搞吵闹的夜市。晚上有个安静、有绿意的广场我会去，可不想再多个架着音响搞活动的地方。

en: Using a wheelchair here takes planning. A blocked footpath can mean doubling back, and finding somewhere shaded to wait is hit and miss.
zh: 坐轮椅在这边出门得提前想好路线。人行道一被堵就可能得往回绕，能不能找到阴凉地方等人也全看运气。

en: Not sure about the building, honestly. For the square, big shade trees and benches where you can watch children without sitting in full sun.
zh: 那栋楼我还说不好。广场的话，希望有能遮阴的大树和长椅，看着孩子玩的时候不用一直晒太阳。

en: Traffic gets in the way of what could be a pleasant walk. I wouldn't miss that car park, even though others seem attached to it.
zh: 本来可以好好散步，总被车流打断。那个停车场拆了我不心疼，虽然看起来不少人舍不得。

en: More pedestrian space could help our lunch trade, provided deliveries still work. Add shaded seating and toilets so people actually stay, rather than just pass through.
zh: 步行空间多些，可能对我们午餐生意有帮助，但也得留好送货的办法。有阴凉座位和厕所，大家才愿意待着，不只是路过。

en: It's a practical shortcut between the bus and train, not somewhere I stop. On hot afternoons I just want to get through it quickly.
zh: 这里对我来说就是换乘公交和火车的近路，不会特意停留。下午热起来，只想赶紧走过去。

en: Give us shade and a crossing on Wentworth Street that doesn't feel like a gamble. I'd use the square just to sit on my way home.
zh: 希望有树荫，Wentworth街也能有个让人放心过马路的地方。回家路上能在广场坐一会儿，我就会去。

en: The station is close, but getting across the roads feels harder than it should. Everyone bunches up at the lights when a train is due.
zh: 车站明明很近，过几条马路却挺费劲。赶火车的时候，红绿灯前总挤着一堆人。

en: Please keep a clear walking route through it. Market stalls are fine, just not blocking the way to the station.
zh: 请留一条顺畅的步行通道。摆摊没问题，别把去车站的路堵住就行。

en: Mostly I rush through. The bus interchange is handy, but the walk from there feels all traffic and concrete.
zh: 基本都是匆匆路过。公交换乘挺方便，就是从那边走过来，感觉周围除了车就是水泥地。

en: I'd love Chinatown night markets, with local food stalls and performances. Somewhere lively to walk to after dinner instead of staying inside.
zh: 很想要唐人街夜市，有本地小吃摊，也有演出。吃完晚饭能走过去逛逛，总比待在家里强。

en: It's convenient living here, but noisy enough already. I'm not convinced another event space is what this bit needs.
zh: 住这儿是方便，可现在已经够吵了。我不太确定这一带还需不需要再弄个活动场地。

en: Keep somewhere customers can park and somewhere deliveries can stop. A nice square won't help our shop if getting stock in becomes a nightmare.
zh: 得给顾客留停车的地方，也得让送货车能停。要是进货都变得麻烦，广场再漂亮也帮不了我们店。

en: Honestly, the car park makes the place feel like a shortcut, not a neighbourhood. I'd rather walk past people than parked cars.
zh: 说真的，那个停车场让这里像条抄近路的通道，不像个生活的地方。我宁愿路边有人活动，也不想全是停着的车。

en: A covered spot to wait would do me. And signs pointing to the buses, because I still take the wrong turn sometimes.
zh: 有个能遮雨的等候地方就挺好。再加点去公交站的指示牌，我到现在偶尔还会走错。

en: The food is the best part. You can have a lovely meal, then step outside and find there's nowhere pleasant to linger.
zh: 这里最吸引人的还是吃的。饭吃得挺开心，出来却找不到一个舒服点、能多待一会儿的地方。

en: Let Chinatown businesses help choose the events. Please don't just put up a decorative arch and call it culture.
zh: 办什么活动，应该让唐人街的商家也参与决定。别只立个好看的牌楼，就算有文化特色了。

en: I come for dinner, but I'm never quite sure where Chinatown starts. Maybe that's just me. The bakeries are worth the trip anyway.
zh: 我一般来吃晚饭，但总搞不清哪边才算唐人街。也可能是我没留意吧，反正这里的饼店值得专门跑一趟。

en: No amplified music late at night, please. A square can be welcoming without turning into an outdoor venue every weekend.
zh: 拜托晚上晚些时候别再用音响放音乐了。广场可以有人气，但没必要每个周末都变成露天演出场。

en: Some corners feel gloomy after the shops shut. I usually stick to the busier route home, even though it's longer.
zh: 商店关门后，有些角落就显得暗暗的。我回家一般宁愿绕点路，也走人多的那边。

en: Trees, toilets and seats. Get those right before the fancy stuff.
zh: 树、厕所、座椅。先把这些做好，再考虑花里胡哨的。

en: I use that car park when carrying groceries. People say just walk, but that isn't always practical, especially in heavy rain.
zh: 买完菜拎着东西时，我会用那个停车场。有人总说走路就好，可实际没那么简单，尤其碰上下大雨。

en: Replace the parking, definitely. I'd like a shady place for neighbours to meet, with enough open space that you don't have to buy something.
zh: 我赞成把停车场改掉。想要一个有树荫、邻居能碰面聊天的地方，空间宽敞些，不消费也能自在待着。

en: Maybe I'm missing something, but it doesn't feel like a place to spend time now. Also, the takeaway bins always seem full.
zh: 也许是我没发现吧，现在这里真没什么让人想待下来的感觉。还有，装外卖垃圾的桶好像老是满的。

en: Could there be room for small cultural festivals, not just big commercial events? I'd enjoy stumbling across dancing or music on a walk.
zh: 能不能也给小型文化节留点空间，别全是大型商业活动？散步时偶遇跳舞或音乐表演，感觉会挺好。

en: The awkward bit is crossing near turning cars when I'm heading for the station. I don't really notice the rest.
zh: 去车站时最别扭的就是过马路，还得防着转弯的车。其他地方我其实没怎么留意。

en: Not sure about the new building. I'd want sunlight in the square, rather than a windy gap beneath apartments.
zh: 新楼这个事我还拿不准。希望广场能晒到太阳，别最后成了公寓楼底下一个风很大的空隙。

en: Lunch trade is decent around Church Street. After dark it varies, and people asking how to walk to the station is a regular thing.
zh: Church街这边午餐生意还可以，天黑以后就不一定了。经常有人来问，去车站该怎么走。

en: Make the crossings easier for wheelchairs and shopping trolleys. Pretty paving means nothing if the kerbs are still a struggle.
zh: 过街的地方得方便轮椅和买菜小推车通行。路面铺得再漂亮，路缘上下不方便也没用。

en: There are good restaurants here, but the street doesn't really invite browsing. Customers often eat and head straight back to their cars.
zh: 这里好餐馆不少，但街上没什么让人想顺便逛逛的感觉。顾客常常吃完就直接回车上了。

en: I'd try a night market, I suppose, if it finished at a reasonable time. Mostly I want somewhere peaceful for a morning coffee.
zh: 夜市要是别开得太晚，我大概也愿意去逛逛。不过最想要的，还是一个早上能安静喝杯咖啡的地方。

en: Good food nearby, but walking home from the station feels like dodging driveways and waiting forever to cross. Not somewhere I stop and relax.
zh: 附近吃的不错，就是从车站走回家一路要躲进出车道的车，过马路又等半天。没什么地方让人想停下来歇歇。

en: Give me a night market with proper food stalls and somewhere to sit. Not just an empty paved space with expensive coffee.
zh: 弄个有好吃的夜市，再放些能坐下来吃东西的桌椅。别最后就一片空地，旁边卖着贵咖啡。

en: Mostly I hurry through. The walk between the buses and station gets awkward when people bunch up at the crossings.
zh: 基本都是赶路。公交站和火车站之间那段路，碰上大家挤在路口等灯，就不太好走。

en: Night markets sound nice until you're trying to sleep nearby. Keep amplified music down and have a clear finishing time.
zh: 夜市听着挺好，可住旁边要睡觉就不一样了。音响别开太大，也得有个明确的收摊时间。

en: People come for dinner, but the street can feel rushed rather than welcoming. Delivery pickups sometimes block the space outside our shop.
zh: 来吃晚饭的人不少，但街上总有种匆匆忙忙的感觉，不太留得住人。取外卖的有时会堵在店门口。

en: Keep some parking. Not everyone can carry groceries home or bring visiting relatives by train. A square shouldn't make everyday errands harder.
zh: 还是留些停车位吧。不是谁都能拎着菜走回家，亲戚来访也不一定坐火车。建广场别把日常办事弄得更麻烦。

en: Honestly, the car park makes the area feel like a shortcut. I'd rather walk past trees and people eating than rows of cars.
zh: 说真的，那片停车场让这边像个抄近路的地方。比起一排排车，我更想看到树和坐着吃东西的人。

en: A safe crossing towards the station matters more to me than fancy paving. Shade would be good too, especially while waiting for someone.
zh: 对我来说，往车站方向能安全过马路，比铺得多漂亮重要。也想要点树荫，等人的时候能凉快些。

en: I like having dinner options close by. The late noise is less charming when it drifts into the bedroom, though.
zh: 住这儿吃饭选择多，我挺喜欢。但晚上声音传进卧室，就没那么享受了。

en: Could Chinatown have regular food nights and small cultural performances? I'd go, provided local restaurants are involved rather than pushed aside.
zh: 唐人街能不能定期办美食夜，再来点小型文化表演？我会去，不过得让附近餐馆参与，别把原来的商家挤到一边。

en: There isn't much reason to linger after shopping. I usually just head home. Also, the groceries seem dearer every week.
zh: 买完东西也没什么可待的，我一般直接回家。还有，感觉每次买菜又贵了。

en: Trees, toilets and seats with backs. That's pretty much it.
zh: 有树、有厕所，再放些带靠背的椅子。差不多就这些。

en: Crossing roads around here can be stressful with a pram. Drivers turning in seem to look everywhere except where we're standing.
zh: 推婴儿车在这附近过马路挺紧张的。有些转弯的司机好像哪儿都看，就是看不到站在路边的人。

en: Please keep a clear walking route through the square to the station. Market queues shouldn't spill across it, and lighting needs to be decent.
zh: 请留条穿过广场去车站的通道，别让摊位排队的人把路堵了。晚上照明也得做好。

en: It's convenient for changing between bus and train, but I rarely notice anything except traffic lights and whether I'm running late.
zh: 公交换火车倒是方便，不过我通常只顾着看红绿灯，算自己会不会迟到，别的真没怎么留意。

en: Get rid of the car park and make the square genuinely pleasant to walk through. Please don't fill every corner with things to buy.
zh: 把停车场改掉，让广场真正适合走走。也别每个角落都塞满卖东西的，留点不花钱也能待的地方。

en: Some evenings feel lively in a good way. Other nights it's engines revving and people shouting after dinner. Depends when you're out.
zh: 有些晚上热闹得挺舒服，有些晚上就是轰油门、吃完饭大声喊。看你什么时候出门吧。

en: Maybe a little play area? Not sure how it fits with food stalls, but somewhere kids can do more than sit still would help.
zh: 也许可以有个小游乐区？不知道跟美食摊怎么安排，不过孩子能有点活动的地方，总比一直干坐着好。

en: Our lunch trade relies on people walking from the station. Road crossings break up that flow, and rubbish near the kerb doesn't help.
zh: 我们午市主要靠从车站走过来的客人。几个路口走走停停，不太顺，路边的垃圾也影响观感。

en: I'd love evening food stalls, but sort out bins and cleaning first. Nobody wants to wake up to greasy wrappers blowing around.
zh: 我很想晚上有吃的摊位，但垃圾桶和清洁得先安排好。谁也不想一早起来，看见油腻的包装纸满地飞。

en: It's handy living near everything, though summer walks across the hard surfaces are rough. I end up choosing routes for shade, not distance.
zh: 住这儿去哪儿都方便，就是夏天那些铺满硬地的路走着太晒。我选路都先看有没有阴凉，不看远近了。

en: No big event speakers facing the homes, please. I'd use a quiet square for a takeaway dinner more than a packed entertainment venue.
zh: 办活动的大音箱别朝着住宅。我更愿意拿份外卖到安静的广场吃，不想楼下变成挤满人的演出场地。

en: I don't mind the bustle. The awkward bit is finding somewhere comfortable to wait when meeting people near the station.
zh: 热闹点我不介意。比较烦的是约人在车站附近碰面，想找个舒服点的地方等着都难。

en: Some shelter when it rains would help. And please make the new building leave the square feeling open, not like a leftover gap.
zh: 下雨时能有地方避雨就好了。新楼也别把广场挤成剩下的一块空地，还是得有开阔的感觉。

en: I'm a bit torn. The parking is useful, but that patch isn't exactly lovely. Mostly I just want crossing Wentworth Street to feel easier.
zh: 我有点纠结。停车场确实有用，可那块地方也真谈不上好看。主要还是希望过 Wentworth Street 能轻松点。

en: Please provide comfortable seating, clean public toilets, pram space, and covered areas so people can stay outside when it rains.
zh: 希望有舒服的座位、干净的公共厕所、放婴儿车的地方，还有遮雨空间，下雨天也能坐一会儿。

en: It is busy and a bit hard to navigate, especially around the car park and station entrances during the afternoon rush.
zh: 这里平时挺忙的，下午高峰尤其不好走，停车场和车站入口附近总是人车混在一起。

en: A direct, weather-protected route to the station would help, with obvious signs and drainage that does not leave puddles.
zh: 最好有一条直达车站、能遮风挡雨的路线，指示牌清楚一点，地面也别一下雨就积水。

en: There are plenty of people passing through, but not many places to sit quietly or wait without buying something.
zh: 经过的人很多，但能安静坐着等一会儿的地方不多，不消费就很难找到座位。

en: I would love occasional night markets, provided they finish at a reasonable time and do not blast music into nearby homes.
zh: 我喜欢偶尔办夜市，但要按时结束，音乐别放得太响，不能影响附近居民休息。

en: The paving gets slippery and puddled after rain, and the current car park feels more useful than attractive.
zh: 一下雨地面就滑，还会积水；现在的停车场虽然实用，但看起来确实不太舒服。

en: Make the whole square genuinely wheelchair-friendly, with level paths, ramps, accessible toilets, and seating beside the main routes.
zh: 整个广场都要方便轮椅通行，有平整的路、坡道、无障碍厕所，主要通道旁还要安排座位。

en: At the moment I mostly hurry through, dodging buses, delivery vehicles, and people crossing in different directions.
zh: 现在我基本都是匆匆穿过去，要躲公交车、送货车，还要小心各个方向过来的人。

en: I support more open space, but please keep some convenient parking nearby for people carrying shopping or helping older relatives.
zh: 我支持多一点开放空间，但附近最好保留一些方便停车的地方，买东西或陪老人时会需要。

en: It feels lively around the shops, though deliveries, traffic, and bins can make the footpaths cramped and unpleasant.
zh: 商店周围挺热闹，不过送货、车辆和垃圾桶常常把人行道挤得很窄，走起来不太舒服。

en: Give us shade, backs on the benches, and enough seating for families rather than only hard decorative objects.
zh: 希望有遮阴、有靠背的长椅，座位要够家庭使用，不要只摆一些看着好看却坐不了的东西。

en: It feels rushed and cluttered now, with traffic close by and nowhere pleasant to pause between the station and shops.
zh: 这里现在让人觉得很匆忙又杂乱，车流离得近，从车站走到商店之间几乎没有舒服的停留处。

en: Keep pedestrian routes wide and simple, especially near the interchange, and add crossings that do not make commuters take long detours.
zh: 人行路线要宽敞、简单，特别是公交换乘站附近；过马路别让通勤者绕很远。

en: There is good food and plenty of activity, but cars and buses dominate the space and make the area feel less welcoming.
zh: 这里吃的东西不错，也很热闹，但汽车和公交车占了太多存在感，让整个地方不够友好。

en: Families need toilets, changing space, safe pram movement, and seats where children can rest without blocking everyone else.
zh: 家庭需要厕所、换尿布的地方、方便婴儿车通行的路线，还要有座位让孩子休息，不挡住别人。

en: The car park is handy when carrying groceries, but it is a pretty bleak-looking part of the neighbourhood.
zh: 买很多东西时停车场确实方便，但它也是附近看起来最冷清、最没生气的地方之一。

en: Please solve the drainage before adding fancy paving; a beautiful square with standing water will quickly become frustrating.
zh: 请先把排水解决，再考虑漂亮的铺装；一个到处积水的广场，很快就会让人烦。

en: It can be noisy at night already, so I am unsure about events unless there are firm hours and good supervision.
zh: 这里晚上已经有点吵了，所以对活动我不太确定，除非有明确的结束时间和有效管理。

en: A cultural square with food stalls, festivals, seating, and clear information would make Chinatown much more enjoyable to visit.
zh: 如果有小吃摊、节庆活动、座位和清楚的介绍，这个文化广场会让唐人街更值得来逛。

en: There is too much hard surface and not enough greenery, shade, or somewhere comfortable to sit during warmer weather.
zh: 现在硬地面太多，绿化、遮阴和舒服的座位太少，天气热时很难待得住。

en: I would accept removing the car park if the new square has accessible drop-off areas, toilets, benches, and reliable maintenance.
zh: 如果新广场有无障碍上下客区、厕所、长椅，而且维护到位，我可以接受取消这个停车场。

en: The area works as a transport connection, but waiting around is uncomfortable, especially when buses are late or rain starts.
zh: 这里作为交通换乘点还行，但等车很不舒服，尤其是公交晚点或者突然下雨的时候。

en: Include flexible space for small events, plenty of bins, drinking water, toilets, and benches that are easy to clean.
zh: 要有能办小活动的弹性空间、足够的垃圾桶、饮水处、厕所，还有容易清洁的长椅。

en: It is mostly somewhere to pass through, not somewhere I would choose to spend an afternoon.
zh: 这里现在主要就是路过的地方，我不会特意选择在这里过一个下午。

en: Keep it safe and well maintained, with useful benches, lighting, shade, and toilets rather than an impressive space nobody uses.
zh: 要安全、好维护，有真正实用的长椅、照明、遮阴和厕所，不要建成看起来漂亮却没人用的地方。

en: It's handy for dinner and groceries, but some corners feel gloomy after the shops close. I take the longer, brighter way home.
zh: 吃饭买菜都方便，就是店铺关门后有些角落黑乎乎的。晚上回家我宁愿绕点路，走亮堂的地方。

en: Give me a well-lit, direct walk to the station. Please don't put market stalls right across the path when everyone's rushing.
zh: 去车站的路要亮，也要好走。大家赶车的时候，别让市集摊位把通道堵住了。

en: Honestly, the car park is ugly, but we use it. Getting shopping upstairs is already enough of a pain.
zh: 说实话，停车场是不好看，可我们确实用得上。买完东西搬上楼已经够折腾了。

en: Night markets would be lovely. Somewhere bright to grab a snack and sit outside, without needing to buy a full restaurant meal.
zh: 有夜市就挺好，晚上亮亮堂堂，买点小吃坐在外面，不用每次都进餐馆吃一顿。

en: Mostly I just hurry through. The bus connection feels confusing, especially when it's dark and raining.
zh: 平时都是匆匆走过。换乘公交那段不太好找路，天黑又下雨的时候尤其烦。

en: Not keen on night markets outside my window. Trees, decent lighting and somewhere quiet to sit would do me.
zh: 不太想窗外就是夜市。有树、有照明，再有个安静能坐坐的地方，我就满意了。

en: The takeaway places are useful after a late shift. Once they shut, the walk to the buses feels pretty deserted.
zh: 下晚班还能买点外卖，这点挺方便。店一关，走去公交站那段就冷冷清清的。

en: Lose the car park. I'd rather have shade and room to walk than another space dominated by cars.
zh: 停车场就拆了吧。我更想要树荫和宽敞的人行空间，不想走到哪儿都是车。

en: I like hearing different languages and smelling dinner cooking. The overflowing bins sometimes spoil it, though.
zh: 听着各种语言，闻着饭菜香，还挺有生活气息的。不过垃圾桶有时满得往外冒，挺扫兴。

en: I'd come for food stalls and small cultural events. Keep the nearby restaurants visible, not hidden behind a wall of temporary tents.
zh: 有小吃摊和文化活动，我会愿意来逛。不过别搭一排帐篷，把旁边餐馆的门面全挡住了。

en: It's not all scary at night. When restaurants are busy, I feel quite comfortable walking around. Closed shopfronts make a difference.
zh: 晚上也不是哪儿都让人害怕。餐馆热闹的时候，走着挺安心的。一排店都关了门，感觉就不一样。

en: Please keep some short-stay parking nearby. Not everyone can carry shopping home, and the little shops need customers who drive too.
zh: 附近还是留点临时停车位吧。不是谁都能拎着东西走回家，小店也需要开车来的客人。

en: Too much hard paving. Summer walks feel like a chore.
zh: 到处都是硬地面，夏天出门走一趟真受罪。

en: Maybe softer lighting near the apartments, brighter along the paths? I want to feel safe without a floodlight shining into the bedroom.
zh: 能不能步道照亮一点，住宅旁边柔和一点？想晚上走路安心，也不想卧室被大灯照得通亮。

en: We get passing customers from the station, but deliveries are awkward. Drivers circle around while we're trying to get stock inside.
zh: 车站过来的路人会进店消费，但送货挺麻烦。我们等着搬货，司机还在外面绕圈找地方停。

en: More evening foot traffic would help us trade. Just sort out loading access before changing the streets, not after the trucks start getting stuck.
zh: 晚上人多些，对生意有帮助。但改路之前先把卸货安排好，别等货车进不来了才想办法。

en: The shops make it convenient, but crossing around turning cars is stressful. Sometimes I feel like I'm in everyone's way.
zh: 楼下有店确实方便，可过马路老得留神转弯的车。有时候走着都觉得自己碍了车的路。

en: A public toilet that actually stays clean. That's my main thing.
zh: 有个公共厕所，而且能一直保持干净。我最在意这个。

en: I come for the food, but it's hard to tell where to wander afterwards. Some stretches look shut even when businesses are open.
zh: 我主要来吃东西，吃完却不知道还能往哪儿逛。有些地方明明店还开着，看上去却像都打烊了。

en: Let restaurants put a few tables outside, with a clear walking lane. No amplified music every evening, please. We still live here.
zh: 餐馆外摆些桌椅可以，但要留出好走的通道。别天天晚上用音响放音乐，这里还有人住呢。

en: Early mornings are alright. Coming back late, I stick near open shops because the light and people make me feel less exposed.
zh: 一大早走还行。晚上回来，我会贴着还营业的店走，有灯有人，心里踏实点。

en: I'd like Chinatown to feel lived-in, not just decorated for photos. Affordable little shops and regular community activities would bring me downstairs.
zh: 希望唐人街有生活味，不只是摆些装饰让人拍照。有实惠的小店、经常办点社区活动，我才愿意下楼逛。

en: Can't say I notice much beyond the crossings. Usually I'm thinking about whether I've missed my train again.
zh: 除了过马路，其他真没怎么留意。一路都在想，是不是又赶不上火车了。

en: Some shelter, clear signs to the buses and lighting without dark gaps. A working drinking fountain wouldn't hurt either.
zh: 有地方避雨，去公交站的指示清楚些，灯光别亮一段黑一段。再有个能正常用的饮水台就更好了。

en: I enjoy the bustle, honestly. But late rubbish collections and delivery noise already carry upstairs, so I worry about adding more.
zh: 说真的，我挺喜欢这儿的热闹。但夜里收垃圾、送货的声音已经能传到楼上，就怕以后更吵。

en: Good lighting, clear paths and somewhere to sit would help. I do not want to cross a dark square rushing between the station and buses.
zh: 灯光要充足，路要清楚，还要有地方坐。我不想在车站和公交换乘之间，赶路经过一个黑漆漆的广场。

en: Church Street is busy but messy, with cars, deliveries and pedestrians competing for space. The area feels lively, though the footpaths can be frustrating.
zh: Church Street 很热闹，但有点乱，汽车、送货车和行人都在抢空间。这里有活力，不过人行道有时真的很难走。

en: Keep some short-stay parking nearby for people carrying shopping or equipment. A square is welcome, but removing every convenient parking space would hurt.
zh: 附近要保留一些临时停车位，方便搬购物袋或设备。广场当然不错，但把所有方便的车位都取消，会影响很多人。

en: I mostly pass through. It is crowded around the interchange, and signs are not always obvious when people are hurrying for a train.
zh: 我主要只是经过这里。换乘站附近很拥挤，大家赶火车时，指示牌也不总是容易看懂。

en: Make it a direct, easy route, not a pretty obstacle course. Shade, lighting and wide crossings matter more to commuters than fancy paving.
zh: 请把它做成直接好走的路线，不要变成漂亮但碍事的迷宫。对通勤者来说，遮阴、照明和宽一点的过街处比高级铺装重要。

en: The precinct is convenient but noisy, especially with traffic and late-night activity. The current car park is ugly, yet it does provide useful parking.
zh: 这片区很方便，但噪音不少，尤其是车流和夜间活动。现在的停车场不好看，可确实提供了有用的停车位。

en: I would like trees, comfortable seating and strong lighting at night. Please design it so families and older people feel comfortable staying, not just passing through.
zh: 我希望有树、舒服的座位，还有晚上够亮的照明。设计上要让家庭和长者敢于停留，而不只是匆匆经过。

en: It feels like leftover space between roads and buildings. There are plenty of people around, but not many pleasant places to pause or meet.
zh: 这里像是道路和建筑之间剩下的一块空地。人很多，但适合停下来或见面的舒服地方不多。

en: I support replacing the car park if the new building includes useful services and the square stays open. I worry it could become too crowded and boxed in.
zh: 如果新楼有实用的服务，而且广场保持开阔，我支持取代停车场。但我担心最后会太拥挤，四周被建筑围住。

en: The street gets a good mix of customers, but rubbish, traffic and uneven footpaths make the frontage look tired. Chinatown has atmosphere, just not enough breathing room.
zh: 街上客人类型很丰富，但垃圾、车流和不平的人行道让沿街环境显得疲惫。唐人街有气氛，只是缺少一点舒展的空间。

en: Please include toilets, drinking fountains and reliable lighting. I would use the square during lunch, but not if it feels unsafe after dark.
zh: 请设置厕所、饮水处和可靠的照明。我中午会用这个广场，但天黑后如果感觉不安全，就不会来。

en: The route to the station works, but it is cramped and full of people stopping suddenly. The car park entrance also makes walking feel less safe.
zh: 去车站的路还能走，但很挤，而且总有人突然停下来。停车场入口也让步行时感觉不太安全。

en: Keep it green and simple, with enough open space for children. I do not want constant loud events outside my home, especially at night.
zh: 希望绿化多一点、设计简单一点，还要有孩子能活动的开阔空间。我不希望家门口总是办很吵的活动，尤其是晚上。

en: It is active most of the day, but loading vehicles block the footpath and customers struggle to find a comfortable place to wait.
zh: 这里大部分时间都很热闹，但装卸车辆经常挡住人行道，客人也很难找到舒服的地方等候。

en: Night markets and cultural events could bring energy and help local shops. They need sensible hours, clean-up plans and enough security so residents can sleep.
zh: 夜市和文化活动可以带来活力，也能帮到本地商家。但要控制时间、安排清洁，还要有足够的安保，让居民能睡觉。

en: There is nowhere inviting to sit, and the existing edges feel hard and exposed. At night I usually walk quickly and keep my phone away.
zh: 这里没有什么让人想坐下来的地方，周边也显得又硬又空。晚上我通常快步走过，手机也不敢拿出来。

en: A square could bring customers to the restaurants, especially with outdoor dining and cultural programming. Please keep deliveries practical and do not remove every parking option.
zh: 广场可以给餐馆带来客人，特别是有户外用餐和文化活动的时候。请让送货仍然方便，也别把所有停车选择都取消。

en: It is handy for transport and food, but the traffic feels aggressive. The car park is not attractive, although losing it may push more cars into residential streets.
zh: 这里交通和吃饭都方便，但车流让人有压力。停车场不好看，可如果取消，可能会把更多车赶到住宅街。

en: Give pedestrians priority, with crossings that are obvious and safe. I would enjoy a small food market, provided it does not slow everyone trying to catch a bus.
zh: 请优先考虑行人，过街处要明显又安全。如果小型美食市集不会耽误赶公交的人，我会很喜欢。

en: The area has strong food and cultural character, but the public space feels unfinished. Some evenings are pleasant; other nights the lighting and litter are a problem.
zh: 这里的饮食和文化特色很鲜明，但公共空间像还没完成。有些晚上很舒服，另一些晚上照明和垃圾就成了问题。

en: I need a safe, well-lit shortcut with room for people carrying bags. Please do not fill it with permanent structures that make the station route longer.
zh: 我需要一条安全、明亮、能让拎着东西的人顺利通过的捷径。请不要放太多固定设施，把去车站的路弄长。

en: The neighbourhood is convenient but has little calm space. Traffic noise, crowds and late-night shouting can be annoying, even though the location is useful.
zh: 这附近很方便，但安静的空间太少。车声、人群和深夜喊叫有时很烦，虽然这里的位置确实很好。

en: I would rather see the car park replaced with a genuine public place than keep more cars here. Just make the edges bright, visible and easy to leave.
zh: 我宁愿把停车场换成真正的公共空间，也不想这里继续容纳更多汽车。但边缘一定要明亮、看得清楚，而且方便离开。

en: It is mostly a rush between buses and trains, with little reason to stop. The crowds are manageable, but cars turning near the interchange are stressful.
zh: 这里大多时候就是在公交和火车之间赶路，没什么理由停下来。人群还可以应付，但换乘站附近转弯的车让人很紧张。

en: Make it welcoming for dining, festivals and small performances, but keep noise under control. Good lighting and visible security would help staff finish late shifts safely.
zh: 希望这里适合吃饭、办节庆和小型表演，但要控制噪音。好的照明和看得见的安保，能让晚班员工更安全地下班。

en: After rain, walking home means dodging puddles and delivery bikes. I like having food places close, but the footpaths feel messy.
zh: 下完雨回家，既要绕水坑，又要躲送餐的车。附近吃东西是方便，就是人行道上有点乱。

en: Sort the drainage before putting in fancy paving. Somewhere dry to sit would get more use than another decorative feature.
zh: 别光顾着铺漂亮地砖，先把排水做好。有个下雨也能坐的地方，比再添什么装饰实用。

en: Honestly, the car park is useful. Carrying groceries home in the rain is already enough of a pain.
zh: 说真的，那个停车场挺有用。下雨天拎着买好的东西回家，本来就够折腾了。

en: I'd happily lose the car park for trees and a proper square. Just don't turn the whole thing into outdoor restaurant seating.
zh: 我愿意把停车场换成有树的广场，但别最后全让餐馆摆桌子，想随便坐坐都没地方。

en: Working around Church Street, I see delivery riders squeezing past customers all evening. They need somewhere to wait without blocking our doorway.
zh: 在教堂街这边上班，晚上总看见外卖骑手从客人旁边挤过去。得给他们留个等单的地方，别堵着店门。

en: Night markets would bring me back. Food stalls, little performances, somewhere to sit with takeaway. Doesn't have to be polished.
zh: 有夜市我会常来。摆点小吃摊，有些小演出，再有地方坐着吃外卖就行，不用搞得多精致。

en: I come for dinner, then usually leave. Not really sure where you'd hang around afterwards, especially when it's wet.
zh: 我一般来吃个晚饭就走了。吃完还能去哪儿坐坐，还真不知道，下雨时更没地方待。

en: Give us a direct, covered walk towards the station. No zigzag paths through cafe tables when everyone's trying to catch a train.
zh: 去火车站的路最好直一点，还能遮雨。赶车的时候，真不想在咖啡桌之间绕来绕去。

en: Rainy days are awkward at the shop. Wet umbrellas by the entrance, puddles outside, and deliveries still need to get through.
zh: 店里一到雨天就麻烦，门口都是湿雨伞，外面又积水，送货的还得从这里进出。

en: Please don't make it a night market every weekend. I'd like somewhere peaceful nearby, not more noise drifting into the flat.
zh: 可别每个周末都办夜市。我想家附近有个安静点的地方，不想关着窗还听见外面吵。

en: It's handy living here, but scooters left across the footpath are getting old. Some days I'm stepping into the rainwater to pass.
zh: 住这边是方便，可滑板车老横在人行道上，真的烦。有时候想过去，只能踩进旁边的积水里。

en: Secure bike parking, please. Not just a lonely rack in the rain.
zh: 请弄个能放心锁自行车的地方，别就放个车架在外面淋雨。

en: The food is good. The bins smell pretty rough when it's warm, though.
zh: 吃的不错。不过天气一热，垃圾桶那股味儿真有点受不了。

en: Maybe a little rain garden, if it actually drains. I don't want a pretty planted puddle breeding mosquitoes beside the seats.
zh: 弄个雨水花园也许不错，但得真能排水。别种得挺好看，结果座椅旁边积着水养蚊子。

en: I like the bustle around dinner time. It feels lived in, not empty. The car park isn't exactly somewhere you want to linger.
zh: 我挺喜欢饭点那股热闹劲，有生活气息，不冷清。现在那个停车场，也实在不是让人想多待的地方。

en: Separate bikes from the main walking route, but don't send riders on a huge detour. That just means everyone ignores the signs.
zh: 自行车和主要步行路线最好分开，但别让骑车的人绕一大圈，不然牌子立了也没人照着走。

en: Between the bus interchange and station, I'm mostly watching my footing when it rains. Slippery bits, puddles, people rushing past.
zh: 从公交换乘站走到火车站，一下雨就得低头看路。有的地方滑，有的地方积水，旁边还都是赶路的人。

en: Keep some parking nearby. A square sounds nice, but not everyone can cycle over or carry shopping on the train.
zh: 附近还是留些停车位吧。广场听着不错，可不是谁都能骑车来，或者拎着大包小包坐火车。

en: There's plenty happening nearby, but not much shade when I just want to get out of the flat for a bit.
zh: 附近挺热闹的，可我只是想下楼透透气时，没多少能遮阴的地方。

en: Make delivery pickup spots obvious and keep them off the station shortcut. Riders are working too; giving them nowhere doesn't solve anything.
zh: 外卖取餐等候区要好找，也别占着去车站的近路。骑手也是在干活，光赶人、不留地方没用。

en: Customers like the restaurants here, but delivery vans and people walking compete for space. When it pours, everyone bunches under the same awnings.
zh: 客人挺喜欢这里的餐馆，就是送货车和行人都挤在一起。一下大雨，大家又全挤到同一片雨棚底下。

en: I'd love Chinatown events in the square, with local businesses involved. Just leave quiet days between them and clean up afterwards.
zh: 希望广场能办些唐人街活动，让附近商家也参与。活动之间留些清静日子，结束后垃圾也得收拾干净。

en: Most mornings I just pass through half asleep. The coffee's decent, which helps.
zh: 早上经过这里，基本还没睡醒。好在咖啡还行，能提提神。

en: Some shelter near the bus side would help. It needs gutters that don't dump water right where you step out.
zh: 靠公交站那边能有个避雨的地方就好了。排水槽也得做好，别一走出雨棚就被浇一身。

en: Maybe it's just me, but the place feels nicer after rain once the traffic eases. Until a scooter splashes through the puddles.
zh: 也许就我这么觉得，雨后车少一点的时候，这里还挺舒服的。直到有辆滑板车冲过水坑，溅得到处都是。

en: I'd come for a proper night market, especially food stalls with somewhere to sit. Just don't make every event expensive to get into.
zh: 有像样的夜市我就会来，特别是有吃的、也有地方坐。别搞得每场活动都要花不少钱才能进去。

en: It's handy for changing between the train and bus, but the walk feels messy. I'm usually watching traffic rather than looking around.
zh: 火车换巴士挺方便，就是中间这段路走得有点乱。平时光顾着看车了，也没心思看看周围。

en: Night markets could bring customers past our shop. Keep our entrances visible during construction, though. A lovely square won't help if we can't survive the works.
zh: 夜市能给店里带点客流。不过施工时别把店门挡住。要是熬不过施工期，广场建得再漂亮也没用。

en: Food nearby is great. The late-night shouting, not so great.
zh: 附近吃的确实不错。半夜还有人在外面大喊大叫，这就不太好了。

en: Keep the parking. Not everyone can carry shopping home on the train, and I don't want a fancy replacement building that costs a fortune.
zh: 停车场还是留着吧。不是谁都能拎着大包小包坐火车回家，也不想花大钱换一栋花里胡哨的楼。

en: Mostly it's somewhere I hurry through. Finding the right bus stop was confusing when I first started coming here.
zh: 对我来说，这里基本就是赶路经过的地方。刚开始来这边时，找对巴士站还挺费劲的。

en: A direct, well-lit route to the station, please. Don't send us round construction fences with no signs while the square gets built.
zh: 去车站的路要直接一点，灯也要够亮。建广场的时候，别让我们绕着围挡走半天，连个指路牌都没有。

en: The afternoon sun is rough when you're waiting around. Sometimes I buy a drink just to have somewhere indoors to stand.
zh: 下午在这边等车晒得够呛。有时买杯喝的，就是想找个室内的地方待一会儿。

en: Honestly, shade and a seat. That's enough for me.
zh: 说真的，有树荫、有地方坐，我就满足了。

en: Some mornings it smells like breakfast and I wish I wasn't rushing. Other mornings it's just traffic noise and a dash for the train.
zh: 有些早上闻到早餐香味，真想停下来吃点。可有时就只听见车声，一路赶着去坐火车。

en: Get rid of the car park and give people room to walk. But show what this will cost before committing to fancy paving.
zh: 把停车场腾出来，让行人走得宽敞点。不过先把要花多少钱讲清楚，别一上来就挑贵的地砖。

en: I come for dinner, but afterwards I'm never quite sure where to wander. The area doesn't really invite you to hang around.
zh: 我会来这边吃晚饭，但吃完总不知道还能去哪儿逛逛。现在这环境不太让人想多待。

en: Please don't turn it into an outdoor nightclub. Food stalls sound fine, but nearby homes need quiet evenings too.
zh: 别弄成露天夜店就好。摆些小吃摊没问题，但住在附近的人晚上也想清静点。

en: It's okay, I suppose. My main complaint is the bus being late, which probably isn't what you're asking about.
zh: 还行吧。我最烦的其实是巴士晚点，不过这大概不是你们想问的事。

en: I'd love evening food stalls and small performances. Give Chinatown some life beyond signs, with local businesses helping decide what happens there.
zh: 希望晚上有小吃摊，也有些小演出。唐人街不能光靠招牌，得真有点人气，办什么活动也该让本地商家参与商量。

en: Lunch trade can be good, then it goes quiet. Talk of construction worries me more than the design pictures excite me.
zh: 午饭时生意有时不错，过了饭点就冷清了。比起那些漂亮效果图，我更在意施工会怎么影响生意。

en: Maybe start with trees, toilets and decent drainage? I'm not convinced we need expensive event equipment before getting the basics right.
zh: 要不先把树、公厕和排水做好？基本的都没弄好，就花钱买活动设备，我觉得没必要。

en: The car park isn't pretty, but it gets used. Around here already feels unsettled whenever footpaths are blocked or works start up.
zh: 停车场是不漂亮，但确实有人用。这边只要一围路、开工，日常出门就变得挺折腾。

en: Less parking, more green space. I'd actually use a quiet square after work, provided the night markets don't take it over every evening.
zh: 少点车位，多点绿地。下班后有个安静的广场，我真会去坐坐，前提是别天天晚上都被夜市占满。

en: I like having restaurants close by, but rubbish left after busy nights is unpleasant. It makes the morning walk feel grubby.
zh: 家附近餐馆多是挺方便，但热闹过后留下的垃圾看着不舒服。早上出门走一圈，感觉脏兮兮的。

en: Keep a clear walking lane through any market. I don't mind the food stalls, but missing my bus behind a queue would get old fast.
zh: 办夜市也得留条畅通的走道。我不反对小吃摊，但要是总被排队的人挡住、赶不上巴士，肯定受不了。

en: It's convenient living here, although some evenings I shut the windows because of the noise. I'm a bit torn about making it busier.
zh: 住这里是方便，不过有些晚上吵得只能关窗。要把这里弄得更热闹，我心里还挺矛盾的。

en: Some shelter from rain would help. Also, please coordinate the works so the station route and bus access aren't disrupted together.
zh: 有个能避雨的地方就好了。另外施工安排协调一下，别去火车站的路和巴士通道同时都受影响。

en: Customers ask about parking before they ask about the menu. Deliveries are awkward too. Still, the street feels better when people linger rather than drive straight through.
zh: 客人还没问菜单，先问能不能停车，送货也不太方便。不过有人愿意停下来逛，总比车子直接开过去更有街区的感觉。

en: Cheap takeaway at a night market would tempt me to stop after work. Just keep the music low enough to hear bus announcements.
zh: 下班路上要是有价格实惠的夜市小吃，我会停下来买点。音乐别太响，至少得听得见巴士广播。

en: It is mostly a rush between buses, trains and traffic. The footpaths feel crowded, especially when people stop suddenly with luggage.
zh: 这里基本就是赶公交、赶火车和躲车流，大家走得很快。人行道经常很挤，尤其有人拖着行李突然停下来时。

en: Make it lively with Chinatown food stalls, cultural performances and seating. But keep construction staged carefully, because small businesses cannot survive months of blocked access.
zh: 希望有唐人街美食摊、文化表演和座位，把这里做得热闹些。但施工一定要分阶段安排，入口堵几个月，小生意真的撑不住。

en: I pass through quickly and do not really notice the area. There are too many crossings, buses and delivery vehicles competing for space.
zh: 我每天只是匆匆经过，平时没太注意这里。路口太多，公交车、送货车和行人都在抢空间。

en: A clear, direct route to the station would help. Please include shade and somewhere to sit, but do not fill the path with events every day.
zh: 如果去车站有条清楚直接的路就好了。希望有遮阴和座椅，但别每天都办活动，把通道堵住。

en: It feels hard and busy now, with little greenery and nowhere pleasant to pause. At night, some corners feel empty rather than welcoming.
zh: 现在这里又拥挤又冷硬，绿化不多，也没什么舒服的地方可以停一会儿。晚上有些角落不是热闹，而是显得空荡荡的。

en: Keep the square open and easy to cross, with good lighting and real shade. Cultural events would be great if commuters can still get through.
zh: 广场要保持开阔、好走，有充足照明和真正能遮阴的地方。如果不影响通勤，办文化活动当然很好。

en: The station connection is useful, but the area is confusing when buses arrive together. I usually keep my head down and hurry through.
zh: 这里去车站很方便，但几辆公交同时到站时就很乱。我通常低着头，赶紧穿过去。

en: Give Chinatown a proper stage for music, food and festivals, not just paving. It should still have a quiet side for people waiting between connections.
zh: 应该给唐人街一个真正能办音乐、美食和节庆活动的舞台，不能只是铺一大片地砖。同时也要有安静的区域，方便等车的人休息。

en: It is noisy, crowded and not very attractive at the moment. I mostly notice roadworks, temporary barriers and people squeezing past each other.
zh: 现在这里很吵、很挤，也不太好看。我最明显的感觉就是施工、临时围挡，还有大家互相挤着走。

en: I would support a welcoming square with trees, toilets, seating and regular Chinatown events. Please control late-night noise and keep the public space genuinely free.
zh: 我支持建一个有树、厕所和座椅的友好广场，也可以经常办唐人街活动。但要控制深夜噪音，公共空间不能到处都要花钱。

en: Church Street is busy but uneven. Some parts feel vibrant, while other sections are cluttered with signs, bins, parked cars and delivery activity.
zh: Church Street 很热闹，但整体不太整齐。有些地方很有活力，另一些地方却被招牌、垃圾桶、停车和送货弄得很乱。

en: Build it around local food and culture, with affordable events rather than expensive programming. Businesses need clear loading access throughout construction and after opening.
zh: 应该围绕本地美食和文化来设计，活动价格也要亲民，别全是昂贵项目。施工期间和建成后，商家都需要清楚、方便的卸货通道。

en: Trading is already difficult when roads are changed or access disappears. Customers want to visit, but they will not fight through confusing barriers and dust.
zh: 现在只要改路或入口被挡，生意就很难做。顾客愿意来，但不会愿意穿过混乱的围挡和满地灰尘。

en: Keep some parking nearby for people carrying shopping or supporting local restaurants. I like the cultural idea, but the project must not become another costly empty space.
zh: 附近最好保留一些停车位，方便买东西或去本地餐馆的人。我喜欢文化广场这个想法，但别最后变成又贵又没人用的空地。

en: There is plenty of movement but not much comfort. I would like somewhere green to sit, and I am worried construction will drag on for years.
zh: 这里人来人往，但没什么舒适感。我想要一块有绿化、能坐下来的地方，也担心施工会拖很多年。

en: A night market could bring energy and support nearby shops, especially if it celebrates Chinese food and other local cultures. Keep fees and road closures reasonable.
zh: 夜市能带来人气，也能帮到周边商店，特别是把中国美食和其他本地文化都展示出来。摊位费用和封路安排要合理。

en: Right now I am focused on getting through safely. Buses, bikes, cars and pedestrians all seem to meet in the same narrow places.
zh: 现在我只关心能不能安全通过。公交车、自行车、汽车和行人，好像都挤在几个狭窄的地方。

en: Please design for everyday residents, not only festivals. Good lighting, shade, drinking water and clean seating matter more than a fancy landmark.
zh: 请为日常住户设计，不要只考虑节庆。好的照明、遮阴、饮水和干净座椅，比一个昂贵的地标更重要。

en: The area has character through its food and older businesses, but it feels fragmented. Traffic dominates, and there is no obvious place to gather.
zh: 这里的美食和老店很有特色，但整体感觉很零散。车流占了主导，也没有一个明显的聚会空间。

en: Make the walking route obvious during construction, with signs people can actually understand. I would enjoy cultural events, but not if they delay every bus connection.
zh: 施工期间要把步行路线标清楚，指示牌也要让人看得懂。我会喜欢文化活动，但不能因此让每趟公交都耽误。

en: It is functional, not inviting. I see crowds, traffic and takeaway rubbish, then move on because there is nowhere comfortable to stop.
zh: 这里能用，但不让人想停留。我看到的是人群、车流和外卖垃圾，然后继续走，因为没有舒服的地方可以坐。

en: Please do not remove all the parking without improving public transport access. A square is useful only when people can reach it easily and safely.
zh: 如果公共交通接驳没有改善，就别把停车位全部取消。广场只有让大家方便、安全地到达，才真正有用。

en: The street has good food and plenty of activity, but construction noise and dust already affect the dining experience. More disruption could push customers elsewhere.
zh: 这条街有好吃的，也很热闹，但施工噪音和灰尘已经影响用餐体验。再增加干扰，顾客可能就去别的地方了。

en: I would use a square with clear paths, free cultural displays and occasional markets. Please keep costs under control and do not make everything ticketed.
zh: 如果有清楚的通道、免费的文化展示和偶尔举办的市集，我会使用这个广场。请控制成本，别什么活动都要买票。

en: At present it is mainly a transfer point. The Chinatown atmosphere is there, but it gets lost among traffic, construction fencing and hurried commuters.
zh: 现在这里主要就是换乘的地方。唐人街的氛围其实在，但被车流、施工围栏和匆匆赶路的人冲淡了。

en: Please make it leafy and cool, with plenty of shade, drinking taps and safe places for bikes and scooters. I would actually use it after work.
zh: 希望这里多种树、够凉快，有饮水处，也有安全的自行车和滑板车停放点。这样下班后我才会真的来用。

en: It feels mostly like hard pavement and traffic at the moment. There are places to eat, but not many comfortable spots to sit without buying something.
zh: 现在这里基本就是硬邦邦的路面和车流。吃东西的地方不少，但不消费就很难找到舒服的座位。

en: Keep the walking route direct to the station, with clear space for bikes, scooters and people carrying bags. Shade would make the morning crossing much better.
zh: 去车站的步行路线要直接，给自行车、滑板车和拎包的人留出清楚的通道。有遮阴的话，早上走过去会舒服很多。

en: The area is busy but confusing, especially when buses, cars and pedestrians all meet near the interchange. Crossing the streets can feel rushed and unpleasant.
zh: 这里很热闹，但有点混乱，尤其是公交车、汽车和行人都挤在换乘站附近时。过马路总觉得匆忙又不舒服。

en: I would like flexible spaces for outdoor dining, small events and deliveries. Please do not block shop access or make loading impossible during busy periods.
zh: 希望有灵活的户外用餐和小型活动空间，也要方便送货。别堵住商店入口，也别让繁忙时段完全没法装卸货。

en: I mainly pass through. It is crowded, noisy and sometimes awkward with delivery vehicles stopping beside the walking path.
zh: 我主要只是路过。这里人多又吵，有时送货车辆停在步道旁边，走起来特别别扭。

en: Make the square easy to cross, not another place where everyone wanders into the commuter path. Covered seating and secure scooter parking would help.
zh: 广场要方便穿行，别变成大家随意挡住通勤路线的地方。有顶棚的座位和安全的滑板车停车位会很有用。

en: I come for food and shopping, but the streets currently feel more functional than welcoming. There is not much greenery or anywhere pleasant to pause.
zh: 我来这里主要吃饭和购物，但现在的街道更像是用来通行的，不太让人想停留。绿化少，也缺少舒服的休息地方。

en: Night markets would be fantastic, with good lighting and seating. Just keep the music reasonable so nearby residents can still sleep.
zh: 如果有夜市就太好了，再配上好的照明和座位。不过音乐别太吵，也要让附近居民能睡觉。

en: It has great food and a lively atmosphere, but walking around in summer is harsh. The pavement gets hot and shade is hard to find.
zh: 这里美食很多，气氛也热闹，但夏天走起来很难受。地面发烫，想找片阴凉地都不容易。

en: Make it feel like a real Chinatown destination, not just a decorated shortcut. Cultural performances, local food stalls and signs in several languages would help.
zh: 希望它真正成为唐人街文化目的地，而不只是装饰过的通道。文化表演、本地小吃摊和多语种标识都会有帮助。

en: The area is handy for restaurants and transport, though it can be messy around bins and service vehicles. I usually do not stay long.
zh: 这里吃饭和换乘都很方便，不过垃圾桶和服务车辆附近有时比较乱。我通常不会在这里停留太久。

en: I want trees, umbrellas and seats that are comfortable for older people and families. A small play area would make the square worth visiting earlier.
zh: 希望有树、遮阳伞，还有适合老人和家庭的舒服座位。要是有个小型游乐区，就会更值得专程来。

en: It is lively around Church Street, but the traffic can be intimidating. Bikes and scooters appear suddenly, and the footpaths feel narrow when it gets busy.
zh: Church Street附近很热闹，但车流有时让人紧张。自行车和滑板车会突然出现，人一多步道就显得很窄。

en: Please keep short-stay access for customers and a proper loading area. If deliveries have nowhere to go, they will simply stop in front of our businesses.
zh: 请保留顾客临时停靠的位置，也要有正规的装卸区。送货没地方停，就只会直接堵在店门口。

en: It is noisy, hot and dominated by cars at present. I like the restaurants, but the public space does not feel designed for neighbours to enjoy.
zh: 现在这里又吵又热，基本被汽车占据。我喜欢这里的餐馆，但公共空间不像是为附近居民享受而设计的。

en: I need a fast, obvious route between buses and trains. Put bike and scooter parking beside, not across, the main pedestrian flow.
zh: 我需要一条在公交和火车之间快速、清楚的路线。自行车和滑板车停车位应放在旁边，别横在主要人流上。

en: It works as a transport connection, but not as a place to linger. There are bottlenecks near crossings, and shade is almost nonexistent.
zh: 这里作为交通连接还行，但不适合停留。过街处容易堵，遮阴的地方几乎没有。

en: Do not fill the square with permanent furniture. Leave room for commuters, pop-up stalls and delivery access, while providing shade along the edges.
zh: 别用固定设施把广场塞满。要给通勤者、临时摊位和送货留空间，同时在边缘提供遮阴。

en: Business is strongest when people can walk easily between shops. At present, parked vehicles and deliveries sometimes make the footpath frustrating to use.
zh: 顾客能轻松步行穿梭于各家商店时，生意才最好。现在停车和送货车辆有时会把步道堵得很难走。

en: A lively square could bring more customers, but late-night noise and rubbish would hurt us. Council needs a clear event and cleaning plan.
zh: 热闹的广场可能带来更多顾客，但深夜噪音和垃圾也会影响我们。市议会需要明确的活动和清洁安排。

en: I usually come when friends suggest a restaurant. The area is colourful and convenient, though the heat, traffic and lack of seating can be tiring.
zh: 通常是朋友推荐餐馆我才会来。这里有特色也方便，不过炎热、车流和座位太少会让人觉得累。

en: Make the bike and scooter routes predictable, with signs and proper parking. I do not want to weave through crowds or leave my bike blocking a doorway.
zh: 自行车和滑板车路线要清楚可预期，配上标识和正规停车位。我不想在人群里绕来绕去，也不想把车挡在门口。

en: It is mostly a pass-through zone for me, with crowds changing quickly around buses. In summer, there is nowhere to escape the sun while waiting.
zh: 对我来说这里主要就是换乘通道，公交附近的人流变化很快。夏天等车时几乎没有地方可以躲太阳。

en: Keep some practical parking nearby, but give pedestrians priority inside the square. Good shade, charging points and clear delivery hours would make it work.
zh: 附近还是要保留一些实用的停车位，但广场里面应优先考虑行人。有遮阴、充电点和明确的送货时段才好用。

en: It feels mostly like a car park and a shortcut now, with not much shade or somewhere pleasant to sit.
zh: 现在这里主要就是停车场和一条捷径，没什么树荫，也没什么舒服的地方可以坐。

en: Good seating, clear paths and lighting would help, especially when changing between the station and buses in the evening.
zh: 如果座位够、路好走、晚上灯光充足，就方便多了，尤其是赶火车和换公交的时候。

en: It is busy and a bit confusing, with cars, buses and pedestrians all squeezing through the same area.
zh: 这里很忙，也有点乱，汽车、公交和行人都挤在一块儿。

en: Please include a safe play space for children, plenty of shade and toilets. I do not want another hard, empty plaza.
zh: 请给孩子留一个安全的玩耍空间，多种树，还要有厕所。我不想再看到一个又硬又空的广场。

en: There are good places to eat, but the area feels scattered and the car park does not make a great first impression.
zh: 这里吃东西的地方不错，但整体比较零散，那个停车场给人的第一印象也不太好。

en: Night markets and cultural events would bring it alive, as long as there are enough bins, toilets and somewhere to sit.
zh: 有夜市和文化活动就会热闹起来，但垃圾桶、厕所和座位一定要够。

en: At present it is noisy, dusty and mainly useful for parking or getting somewhere else.
zh: 现在这里又吵又灰，主要就是停车，或者从这里赶去别的地方。

en: Keep some nearby parking for older people and people carrying shopping, even if the main car park is replaced.
zh: 即使拆掉现在的停车场，也请保留一些附近车位，方便老人和拎着东西的人。

en: The footpaths can feel uncomfortable at night, and there is nowhere for children to wait or play safely.
zh: 晚上走在人行道上有时不太安心，孩子也没有安全等候或玩耍的地方。

en: Make the route to the station direct and weather-protected. I do not want to cross a busy event space every morning.
zh: 去车站的路线要直接，最好能遮风挡雨。我不想每天早上穿过热闹的活动场地。

en: It is lively around Church Street, but the car park interrupts the connection between shops and the street.
zh: Church Street一带很有活力，但停车场把商店和街道之间的联系切断了。

en: A square should feel welcoming for grandparents, prams and kids, with flat surfaces, shade, seating and safe crossings.
zh: 广场要适合老人、婴儿车和孩子，有平整的地面、树荫、座位和安全的过街设施。

en: I mostly pass through. It is functional, but there is little reason to stop and the pedestrian movements are unclear.
zh: 我基本只是路过。这里能用，但没什么值得停留的地方，行人路线也不太清楚。

en: Put seating along the route, not just in the middle, and keep buses, bikes and pedestrians clearly separated.
zh: 座位不要只放在广场中央，沿路也要有；公交、自行车和行人最好明确分开。

en: The station approach is crowded and sometimes stressful, especially when cars are looking for parking.
zh: 去车站的路很拥挤，汽车找车位时尤其让人觉得紧张。

en: Make Chinatown easy to find, with signs, food stalls and small performances, but do not let events block every walkway.
zh: 希望 Chinatown 更容易找到，有清楚的标识、小吃摊和小型表演，但活动别把所有通道都堵住。

en: It is a busy trading area, though loading, parking and pedestrians often compete for the same narrow spaces.
zh: 这里生意很忙，但装卸、停车和行人经常挤在同一块狭窄空间里。

en: A well-designed square could bring customers, but construction and losing convenient parking would hurt small businesses for a while.
zh: 设计好的广场可能带来更多客人，但施工和失去方便的停车位，短期内会影响小商户。

en: There is too much traffic and not enough greenery. Older neighbours need somewhere comfortable to rest while walking home.
zh: 车太多，绿化太少。附近老人回家路上需要有舒服的地方休息。

en: Include real-time transport information, weather cover and obvious signs to the interchange, station and Church Street.
zh: 请提供实时交通信息、遮雨遮阳设施，并清楚标明去公交换乘站、车站和Church Street的方向。

en: It feels more like leftover road space than a proper neighbourhood place, and parking dominates everything.
zh: 这里更像是剩下的一块道路空间，不像真正的社区场所，停车几乎占据了一切。

en: I would visit for food festivals and music, but please control noise and finish events at a reasonable time.
zh: 有美食节和音乐活动我会来，但请控制噪音，活动也要在合理时间结束。

en: Customers can find the shops, but the current layout feels untidy and car-focused rather than welcoming.
zh: 客人找得到商店，但现在的布局比较杂乱，感觉更重视汽车，不太欢迎行人。

en: Keep the square open and green, with room for kids, older people and community gatherings without making residents deal with constant noise.
zh: 广场要开阔、绿意多，能让孩子、老人和社区聚会使用，但别让居民一直忍受噪音。

en: It is a crowded transfer point with little shelter, and the existing car park makes walking around it awkward.
zh: 这里是拥挤的换乘点，遮挡很少，现有停车场也让人走起来很别扭。

en: Night markets would get me coming back. Give the food stalls proper space, with tables where families can sit without blocking shop doors.
zh: 要有夜市，我会常来。小吃摊的位置得安排好，也放些桌椅，让一家人能坐着吃，别堵住店门。

en: There’s good food nearby, but walking with kids feels like constantly watching driveways. Not much room to stop when someone gets tired.
zh: 附近吃的挺好，就是带孩子走路得一直提防出入车道。走累了想停一停，也没什么地方。

en: Please don’t turn it into a late-night party spot. Trees, decent seats and somewhere older people can chat would suit me better.
zh: 别弄成半夜还闹哄哄的地方就好。我更想要树荫、好坐的椅子，还有让老人坐着聊天的地方。

en: Honestly, I use the car park. Carrying groceries home is hard enough already, and I’m not convinced another building helps.
zh: 说实话，那个停车场我平时要用。买完菜拎回家已经够费劲了，再盖栋楼能有什么帮助，我还真不确定。

en: Keep a clear walking route to the station, even during events. I don’t want to squeeze between queues and delivery trolleys.
zh: 去车站的路得一直留通，办活动也一样。我可不想每天从排队的人和送货推车中间挤过去。

en: Mostly I rush through. The shops look interesting, but the walk between the buses and station isn’t somewhere I fancy lingering.
zh: 我基本都是赶路。沿路的店看着挺有意思，但公交站到火车站这一段，没什么让人想多待的感觉。

en: Shade and a working drinking fountain. That’s about it for me.
zh: 有树荫，饮水台能正常出水，我基本就满足了。

en: It can feel lively around dinner, which I like. Later on, the shouting carries, especially when I’m trying to get kids settled.
zh: 晚饭时候挺热闹，这点我喜欢。再晚些，有些叫喊声传得很远，哄孩子睡觉时尤其烦。

en: Make Chinatown feel worth exploring, not just a sign. Small cultural events and shopfronts opening onto the square would draw me in.
zh: 唐人街别光挂个牌子，得真有东西可逛。办些小型文化活动，店铺朝广场开门，我会更愿意进去看看。

en: Customers ask where they can stop to collect orders. Deliveries are awkward too. We spend time sorting that out instead of serving people.
zh: 顾客老问取餐能在哪儿临时停一下，送货也不方便。我们经常忙着协调这些，反而耽误招呼客人。

en: Good lighting without glare, please. I’d like to see where I’m going without the whole square feeling like a floodlit car yard.
zh: 灯要够亮，但别晃眼。晚上能看清路就行，别把整个广场照得像卖车的场地。

en: The car park makes this bit feel like a gap between places. I’d happily lose it for somewhere pleasant to take the kids.
zh: 这片停车场让这里像是两头热闹、中间空了一块。要能换成带孩子待着舒服的地方，我愿意不要它。

en: Maybe public toilets? I’m usually changing buses, and buying a coffee just to ask for a toilet gets old.
zh: 也许该有个公共厕所？我经常在这儿转公交，老得先买杯咖啡再问能不能借厕所，挺烦的。

en: I come for dinner and usually leave straight after. There isn’t an obvious place to sit while waiting for friends.
zh: 我来这儿主要是吃晚饭，吃完通常就走。等朋友的时候，也找不到一个顺便坐坐的地方。

en: Don’t forget loading access when making streets pedestrian-friendly. We need a practical delivery window and a route that doesn’t cut through children playing.
zh: 改善步行环境的时候，别把卸货给忘了。得留出实际能用的送货时段，路线也别穿过孩子玩耍的地方。

en: Being near the station helps, but passing feet don’t always mean customers. People hurry past, and our entrance gets lost in the clutter.
zh: 靠近车站是好事，但路过的人多，不代表生意就好。大家都急着赶路，门口杂七杂八的，店门也不显眼。

en: Somewhere dry to wait would help. Also, why are bus timetables always the thing I struggle to find?
zh: 有个下雨能躲着等人的地方就好了。还有，怎么每回想找公交时刻表都那么费劲？

en: My older relatives like the shops, but crossing the streets tires them out. Drivers seem impatient when anyone takes a little longer.
zh: 家里长辈喜欢来这边逛店，可过马路挺累人的。走得稍微慢一点，就感觉司机不耐烦了。

en: Keep some short-stay parking nearby. A square could bring trade, sure, but customers collecting bulky shopping still need a workable option.
zh: 附近还是得留点短时停车位。广场当然可能带来生意，可买了大件东西来取货的顾客，也得有办法搬走。

en: I like having restaurants close by. The bins and food smells along parts of the walk are less lovely, especially in warm weather.
zh: 住得离餐馆近，我挺喜欢。不过有些路段的垃圾桶和食物味道就不太好了，天热的时候尤其明显。

en: Put seats with backs near the walking route, not right across it. Older people need a rest; commuters need to get through.
zh: 步行路线旁边放些有靠背的椅子，别摆在路当中。老人需要歇脚，赶车的人也得走得过去。

en: It’s convenient, a bit messy, but not terrible. I’m more bothered by broken footpaths than whether the area looks fashionable.
zh: 这里方便，是有点乱，但也没那么差。比起弄得时不时髦，我更在意坑坑洼洼的人行道。

en: I’d bring the kids for a small play area beside outdoor dining. Nothing fancy, just somewhere they’re welcome and we can actually watch them.
zh: 如果露天吃饭的地方旁边有块小游乐区，我会带孩子来。不用多花哨，孩子能自在玩，大人也看得住就好。

en: After work it’s a mix of hungry people, delivery riders and everyone chasing a bus. Sometimes it works, sometimes it’s a scramble.
zh: 下班时，找吃的、送外卖的、赶公交的都挤在一起。有时候还挺顺，有时候就乱成一团。

en: Let nearby shops trade into the evening, but skip amplified music every night. A snack on the way home would be enough for me.
zh: 附近店铺晚上能继续营业就挺好，别天天用音响放音乐。我下班路上能买点吃的，就够了。

en: Lunch trade is decent, but the pavement gets baking hot. People grab food and leave because there's nowhere comfortable to sit outside.
zh: 午饭时生意还行，就是外面人行道晒得发烫。大家买完吃的就走，找不到能舒服坐下来的地方。

en: Night markets could bring people past our doors after work. Give small local businesses a chance, not just the usual big event operators.
zh: 搞夜市能让下班的人多逛逛，也给我们带点生意。摊位要给本地小商家机会，别总是那几家大型活动公司包办。

en: It's mostly a sweaty dash between the bus and train. When it rains, that's a different kind of miserable.
zh: 平时就是从公交站赶去火车站，走得一身汗。碰上下雨也难受，只是换了个难受法。

en: Shade, a seat, a toilet. Honestly, that's enough for me.
zh: 能遮阳，有地方坐，有厕所。说真的，我就这点要求。

en: Pushing a pram around here is fiddly. You keep dodging signs and outdoor tables, then end up waiting in the sun to cross.
zh: 推婴儿车出门挺费劲，一路躲招牌、绕露天餐桌，过马路还得在太阳底下等。

en: I'd come for food stalls and somewhere shady to eat. Please make Chinatown feel like a place to explore, not just a decorative gateway.
zh: 有小吃摊、能在树荫下吃东西，我就愿意来。唐人街得有东西可逛，别光立个好看的牌楼。

en: The restaurants are handy, but evenings can already be loud. I'm not keen on turning every spare bit of space into an event venue.
zh: 附近吃饭是方便，可晚上已经挺吵了。我不太想看到一有空地就拿来办活动。

en: Keep a clear route through to the station. A square won't help if market stalls force everyone into a narrow gap.
zh: 去火车站的路要留宽敞。要是摊位把大家挤到一条窄缝里，这广场也没什么用。

en: I like having dinner nearby without planning a whole outing. Finding a public toilet afterwards is another story.
zh: 住这儿想出去吃个晚饭很方便，不用特意安排。不过吃完想找个公共厕所，就没那么容易了。

en: Keep some affordable parking close by. Customers collecting bulky orders won't suddenly arrive on bicycles because there's a nice square.
zh: 附近还是得留些收费合理的停车位。来拿大件订单的客人，不会因为多了个漂亮广场就改骑自行车。

en: That car park takes up space I'd rather walk through. Around here, cars seem to get the convenient spots and people get the leftovers.
zh: 那块停车场要是能让人穿过去走就好了。这附近感觉方便的地方都给了车，剩下的才轮到行人。

en: Benches with backs and armrests, please. Those concrete blocks look tidy but aren't much use when you actually need a rest.
zh: 长椅请带靠背和扶手。那种水泥方块看着整齐，真想歇一歇的时候并不好坐。

en: Not sure, I mostly watch the crossing lights and hurry through. The coffee nearby is good though.
zh: 说不好，我基本就盯着过街信号灯，赶紧走过去。不过附近咖啡还不错。

en: Step-free paths that don't send wheelchair users the long way round. Also some shelter near the route to the buses, not hidden in a corner.
zh: 无障碍通道别让坐轮椅的人绕远路。去公交站的路边也弄点遮阳挡雨的地方，别全放在角落里。

en: Deliveries are awkward already, especially when people are heading for lunch. Drivers stop wherever they can and everyone gets annoyed.
zh: 现在送货就不太方便，赶上午饭人多的时候更麻烦。司机哪儿能停就停哪儿，大家都窝火。

en: Maybe drinking taps? I forget my bottle half the time. Shade matters more than another fancy bit of paving.
zh: 能不能装点饮水龙头？我老忘带水瓶。比起再铺什么漂亮地砖，遮阳实在多了。

en: Summer afternoons feel harsh here. Even a short walk for groceries turns into hopping between tiny patches of shade.
zh: 夏天下午这边晒得够呛。就出门买点菜，都得一路找那几小块阴凉走。

en: Please don't put amplified music under nearby windows every weekend. Trees and quiet seating would get more use from me than a stage.
zh: 别每个周末都在附近住户窗下用音响放音乐。对我来说，种树、放些能安静坐着的椅子，比搭舞台有用。

en: My wheelchair catches on rough joins in the pavement. People are usually helpful, but I'd rather not need help just getting around.
zh: 我的轮椅走到路面不平的接缝就容易卡。路人一般愿意帮忙，可我更希望出个门不用总麻烦别人。

en: Lose the car park and make the square welcoming. More people lingering could help trade, provided deliveries still have a sensible place to stop.
zh: 停车场可以撤，广场弄得让人愿意待就行。人肯多坐一会儿，对生意也有帮助，不过送货车得有合适的停靠点。

en: There's plenty to eat, not much free space to just exist. Sometimes I don't want to buy a drink to sit down.
zh: 吃东西的地方不少，不花钱就能待着的地方却不多。有时候我只是想坐一下，不想非得买杯喝的。

en: A toilet that's actually open when the buses are running. And lighting that lets you see the path without making everything feel like a car park.
zh: 公交还在跑的时候，厕所也得开着。灯光能照清路就好，别把整个地方弄得跟停车场似的。

en: I come for dinner and usually leave straight after. It's hard to tell where you'd wander next, especially with a pram.
zh: 我一般来吃个晚饭就走，吃完也不知道还能往哪儿逛，推着婴儿车就更不方便了。

en: Public toilets need proper cleaning, not just a ribbon cutting. If they're closed or filthy, people will keep asking to use ours.
zh: 公共厕所不能剪完彩就算了，得有人好好打扫。要是关着或者脏得没法用，大家还是会来借我们的厕所。

en: It's lively, which I like. But on hot days the empty hard surfaces make the whole walk feel hotter than it needs to.
zh: 这边挺热闹，我是喜欢的。就是天一热，那些光秃秃的硬地面晒着，走一路感觉更热了。

en: A clear, direct walking route to the station, with safe crossings and shelter from rain. Please keep bikes and delivery vehicles out of the main pedestrian path.
zh: 希望去车站的路清楚直接，过马路安全，还有地方能遮雨。请别让自行车和送货车辆占用主要人行通道。

en: It feels like a gap between the bus interchange and the station, but crossing the roads can be stressful when traffic is turning.
zh: 公交换乘站和车站之间像缺了一块，尤其车辆转弯时，过马路让人挺紧张。

en: Make it attractive for people to stop, not just pass through. Outdoor dining, shade, lighting and small cultural events could bring customers without blocking shopfronts.
zh: 别让大家只是路过，要让人愿意停下来。可以有户外座位、遮阴、照明和小型文化活动，但别挡住店面。

en: I usually hurry through here. The footpaths are crowded, buses and cars compete for space, and the crossings do not always feel friendly.
zh: 我平时都是匆匆走过这里。人行道很拥挤，公交车和汽车抢空间，过马路也不总让人安心。

en: Night markets could be fantastic for Chinatown and nearby businesses, provided noise, rubbish and trading arrangements are properly managed.
zh: 夜市对唐人街和附近商家都会很棒，前提是噪音、垃圾和摊位安排要管好。

en: There is plenty of movement during the day, but it becomes patchy at night. I notice traffic noise, empty edges and not enough comfortable places to sit.
zh: 白天人来人往，晚上却冷清不少。车声明显，边角位置空荡荡的，舒服的座位也不够。

en: Give us somewhere welcoming to meet before dinner, with trees, toilets, good signs and a stage for festivals or community performances.
zh: 希望吃饭前有个舒服的碰头地点，有树、有厕所、指示清楚，还能举办节庆或社区演出。

en: The area is busy and culturally interesting, though deliveries are awkward and pedestrians sometimes miss our entrance among all the signs and foot traffic.
zh: 这里很热闹，也有文化特色，不过送货不方便，招牌和人流太多时，行人有时找不到我们店门。

en: I would like a calm, green square with seating, shade and room for children, while still feeling safe after dark.
zh: 我希望这里是安静、绿意多的广场，有座位和遮阴，也有孩子活动的空间，天黑后还要让人觉得安全。

en: Customers like the food and energy here, but parking changes and roadworks can make a short visit feel much harder than it should.
zh: 顾客喜欢这里的美食和热闹气氛，但停车变化和道路施工，会让本来很短的停留变得麻烦。

en: Please do not design a beautiful square that forgets workers. Keep loading access practical, add clear wayfinding, and support events that bring people into local shops.
zh: 别只顾着把广场做漂亮，却忘了这里工作的人的需要。装卸通道要实用，指引要清楚，也要支持能带动商铺的活动。

en: Getting across the main roads is the worst part. Cars turn quickly, and the footpaths can feel tight when everyone is heading to the station.
zh: 最糟糕的是过主干道。车辆转弯很快，大家都往车站走时，人行道感觉特别挤。

en: More trees, benches and lighting would help. I am unsure about closing more streets, but safer walking routes to Chinatown would be a real improvement.
zh: 多种些树、放些长椅、加强照明都会有帮助。我不确定是否该再封更多街道，但去唐人街的步行路线更安全肯定是好事。

en: It is lively, but messy at times, with bins, queues and delivery vehicles competing for the same space. The area needs better coordination.
zh: 这里很有活力，但有时也挺乱，垃圾桶、排队的人和送货车都在抢同一块地方。整体需要更好的协调。

en: Make it a proper cultural meeting place, with Chinese festivals, food stalls, music and art—not just another paved space with a few seats.
zh: 希望它真正成为文化聚集地，有中国节庆、美食摊位、音乐和艺术活动，而不是铺满地面、只摆几张椅子的普通广场。

en: The station connection brings people past us, but many keep moving. The streets feel confusing, especially when buses, taxis and pedestrians arrive together.
zh: 车站带来很多经过的人，但多数人不会停留。公交车、出租车和行人同时到来时，街道尤其让人摸不清方向。

en: Keep some parking nearby for customers who cannot walk far. I support better pedestrian areas, but access cannot be treated as an afterthought.
zh: 请在附近保留一些停车位，方便走不了太远的顾客。我支持改善步行环境，但不能最后才考虑车辆到达的问题。

en: Chinatown has great character, but it can feel disconnected from the station. Crossing the road with shopping bags or deliveries is frustrating.
zh: 唐人街很有特色，但和车站之间感觉不太连贯。提着购物袋过马路，或者搬运货物时，都很让人烦。

en: I want a place where neighbours can sit without buying anything, with regular cultural events and enough quiet corners for reading or relaxing.
zh: 我想要一个不用消费也能坐下来的地方，有定期文化活动，也留一些安静角落供人看书或放松。

en: It is convenient but hard-edged. There are busy roads, limited shade and nowhere obvious to pause between the station, shops and home.
zh: 这里交通方便，但整体太生硬。道路繁忙，遮阴不够，从车站、商店回家路上也没什么明显的休息点。

en: Please keep the square open and flexible. A market one weekend and a quiet garden the next would suit more people than permanent structures.
zh: 希望广场保持开放和灵活。这个周末办市集，下个周末变成安静的花园，比建很多固定设施更适合大家。

en: At night I avoid some corners because they are too dark and empty. During the day, noise and crowds make walking less relaxing.
zh: 晚上有些角落太黑又没什么人，我会避开。白天噪音和人群又多，走路并不轻松。

en: I would welcome fewer cars and easier crossings, but not constant event noise. Good lighting, trees and clear closing times would make the space work.
zh: 我欢迎减少汽车、让过马路更容易，但不希望活动噪音一直不断。照明、树木和明确的活动结束时间会让这里更好用。

en: The area has good food and transport, but it feels like a place to pass through rather than somewhere residents can enjoy.
zh: 这里有好吃的，也方便乘车，但更像一个路过的地方，不太像居民可以真正享受的空间。

en: Add public toilets, drinking fountains, seating and shade. Make the route to the station obvious, and give Chinatown room to show its culture proudly.
zh: 请增加公共厕所、饮水处、座位和遮阴。去车站的路线要一目了然，也要给唐人街足够空间展示自己的文化。

en: It feels crowded and a bit messy now, especially around the car park. There are good food places, but crossing the roads with shopping bags is stressful.
zh: 现在这里人多又有点乱，尤其是停车场附近。吃饭的地方不错，但提着东西过马路挺让人紧张。

en: I’d use the square if it had a clear, sheltered walking route to the station, plenty of crossings, and somewhere quick to grab breakfast.
zh: 如果广场有清楚、遮雨的步行路线通往车站，还有方便过马路的地方和能快速买早餐的小店，我会用。

en: There is always traffic noise, but I like the mix of restaurants and people. It could feel much safer and more welcoming after dark.
zh: 这里一直有车声，不过餐馆多、人气足，我喜欢这种感觉。晚上如果更安全、更有灯光，应该会舒服很多。

en: Make it easy to cut through on the way to buses. A lively night market would be great, provided it does not block commuters.
zh: 最好让人去公交站时能顺畅穿过。要是有热闹的夜市就更好了，但别把通勤的人堵住。

en: It is mostly a fast walk between traffic, buses and station entrances. I rarely stop, because the footpaths feel cramped and crossings take too long.
zh: 这里基本就是在车流、公交和车站入口之间赶路。我很少停下来，因为人行道挤，过马路也经常要等很久。

en: Give pedestrians priority, with shade, seating and a direct station path. Food stalls would make waiting for a bus less boring.
zh: 应该优先考虑行人，增加遮阳、座位和直达车站的路线。有些小吃摊，等公交时也不会那么无聊。

en: I come for the restaurants and Chinatown atmosphere, but the streets can be noisy and confusing. It is hard to find a comfortable place to pause.
zh: 我会来这里吃饭，喜欢唐人街的氛围，但街上有时又吵又绕，很难找到一个舒服的地方坐下来。

en: Please include obvious signs between the square, station and interchange. I support markets and performances, as long as a quiet route remains available.
zh: 广场、车站和公交换乘处之间要有明显指引。我支持市集和表演，但一定要保留一条安静、好走的路线。

en: The current walk is functional, not pleasant. Cars turn quickly near the crossings, and the pavement gets uncomfortable when everyone is heading for the station.
zh: 现在这段路能走，但谈不上舒服。过街处车辆转弯很快，大家一起赶车时，人行道特别难走。

en: The square should support outdoor dining and evening food events, with power, lighting and easy cleaning. Noise needs managing, but some energy is good for business.
zh: 广场最好支持户外用餐和晚间美食活动，电源、照明和清洁都要提前做好。噪音要管，但有点人气对生意是好事。

en: There is plenty of passing trade, though deliveries, buses and pedestrians compete for the same space. At night the area can feel either lively or too loud.
zh: 这里经过的人不少，但送货车、公交和行人总在抢同一块空间。晚上有时很热闹，有时又吵过头。

en: I want trees, comfortable seats and a proper night market. Please keep it welcoming for families, not just another hard-paved event space.
zh: 我想要树、舒服的座椅，还有真正像样的夜市。这里应该适合家庭来，不要又变成一块冷冰冰的活动场地。

en: The area has good food but not much greenery. Cars dominate the edges, and the existing parking lot makes the place feel like a leftover space.
zh: 这里吃的不错，但绿化太少。周边总是车为主，现有停车场也让整个地方像一块被剩下的空地。

en: Keep some parking nearby for people carrying groceries, but do not let cars take over. I would like weekend food stalls and somewhere to sit.
zh: 附近还是要留一点停车位，方便买菜买东西的人，但别让汽车占满。周末有小吃摊和可以坐的地方就好了。

en: It is busy and convenient, but crossing Wentworth Street can be frustrating. The restaurants bring life, while the footpaths and traffic make walking tiring.
zh: 这里热闹又方便，但过温特沃思街有时很烦。餐馆带来了活力，可人行道和车流也让走路很累。

en: A good square needs toilets, shade, drinking water and lighting. I would rather have a calm public place than constant loud events.
zh: 一个好广场需要厕所、遮阳、饮水处和照明。我更希望这里是安静的公共空间，不要天天都有很吵的活动。

en: Most days it is just somewhere I pass through. There are interesting shops, but the traffic noise and patchy paving make the area feel unfinished.
zh: 大多数时候我只是经过这里。附近有些有意思的店，但车声很大，路面又不平整，整体感觉还没做好。

en: Connect it properly to nearby streets and the station, with safe crossings at both ends. Occasional music and food would make it feel alive.
zh: 要把广场和周边街道、车站真正连起来，两头都设置安全的过街设施。偶尔有音乐和美食活动，会更有生气。

en: The area already attracts diners, but people often hurry past after eating. More seating, signs and evening activity could help visitors stay longer.
zh: 这里本来就能吸引吃饭的人，但很多人吃完就匆匆离开。多些座位、指引和晚间活动，大家可能会多待一会儿。

en: Please make loading access practical for shops. A regular food market could bring customers, but it should finish at a reasonable time and leave entrances clear.
zh: 一定要让商铺送货方便。固定的美食市集能带来客人，但结束时间要合理，店铺入口也不能被挡住。

en: It is noisy, crowded and useful. I can get food quickly, but the final stretch to the station feels unsafe when cars rush through.
zh: 这里又吵又挤，但确实方便。我能很快买到吃的，只是最后走去车站那段，车辆冲过来时让人不太安心。

en: The main thing is a straight, comfortable route to the station. Add seating and food, but keep enough open space for people changing buses.
zh: 最重要的是有一条直达车站、走起来舒服的路线。可以加座位和吃东西的地方，但要留够空间给换乘公交的人。

en: I mostly notice buses, road noise and crowds moving in different directions. The food is good, though the crossings are not friendly when you are in a hurry.
zh: 我最明显的感受是公交、车声，还有四处赶路的人。食物不错，可赶时间时，过马路真的不太方便。

en: Make it a real destination with Chinese festivals, night markets, good lighting and interesting food. I would visit more often if it felt comfortable after dinner.
zh: 可以办中国节庆、夜市，配上好的照明和有特色的美食，把这里做成真正的目的地。如果晚饭后也舒服安全，我会更常来。

en: It is an awkward gap between the interchange, shops and station. People stream through, but there is little reason to stop and the crossings feel rushed.
zh: 这里夹在公交换乘处、商店和车站之间，走起来有点别扭。人一直经过，却没什么理由停下，过马路也总是很赶。

en: Give me a dry place to sit while waiting for the bus, with a clear path through. Don't put benches right across everyone's shortcut.
zh: 等公交时能有个避雨的地方坐就好了，穿行的路也得留出来。别把长椅正好摆在大家赶路的道上。

en: After rain, pushing the pram around here is a pain. You dodge puddles and then find the easy way past is blocked by bins.
zh: 下完雨推婴儿车出来真费劲。绕开积水，好不容易找到平坦的路，又被垃圾桶挡住了。

en: Night markets could bring people past our restaurant. I'd support them if rubbish gets collected and customers can still find our doorway.
zh: 办夜市能给我们餐馆带点客流，我赞成。不过垃圾得及时清，摊位也别挡得客人连店门都找不到。

en: I like having food places nearby, but the noise carries into home already. It's not always the quiet neighbourhood the drawings seem to promise.
zh: 附近吃东西方便，这点挺好，但现在外面的声音就已经能传到家里了。效果图看着安静，住着可不一定。

en: Keep some parking close by. Not everyone buying from us can carry things back to the station, especially when it's pouring.
zh: 附近还是得留些停车位。不是每个来买东西的客人都能提着东西走回车站，尤其碰上下大雨。

en: There are places to eat, but hardly anywhere I feel comfortable just sitting without buying something. Sometimes I just head home instead.
zh: 吃饭的地方不少，但想不花钱坐会儿，好像没什么自在的地方。有时候干脆就回家了。

en: Proper accessible toilets, please. Not a locked door and a sign sending wheelchair users somewhere else. Put seating nearby for whoever is waiting.
zh: 无障碍厕所得真正能用，别锁着门，再贴张纸让坐轮椅的人去别处。旁边也放些座椅，方便陪同的人等。

en: Honestly, it's handy. Train, groceries, dinner, all close. The footpaths feel cramped sometimes, but I wouldn't want everything changed just for a prettier picture.
zh: 说实话，住这儿挺方便，坐火车、买菜、吃饭都近。人行道有时有点挤，但也别为了好看就全改了。

en: Lose the car park and make somewhere people actually linger. More shade and decent seats would help our lunch trade more than another driveway.
zh: 我倒觉得可以把停车场撤了，腾个让人愿意停留的地方。多点树荫和舒服的座椅，比多个车道口更能带动午餐生意。

en: The puddles hang around long after the rain stops. My shoes are usually the first thing I complain about when I get home.
zh: 雨停了，地上的水还半天不退。我回家第一件事，经常就是抱怨鞋又湿了。

en: Maybe a covered play corner? I'm not sure a big open square helps much when you've got a pram and nowhere dry to stop.
zh: 能不能弄个有顶的儿童活动角？推着婴儿车出来，连个干爽的落脚处都没有，广场再空旷好像也没多大用。

en: It's busy around dinner time, which I enjoy. The takeaway smells are tempting. Finding a clean public toilet is another story.
zh: 晚饭时间挺热闹，我还蛮喜欢的，外卖店飘出来的味道也馋人。就是想找个干净的公厕，可没那么容易。

en: No fancy maze. I need a direct, step-free route to the station that doesn't turn into a shallow pond when it rains.
zh: 别搞得像迷宫。去车站的路直接点、别有台阶，下雨也别变成一片浅水塘。

en: I'm mostly rushing through, so I notice slippery paving more than anything cultural. On wet mornings I slow right down near the crossings.
zh: 我大多赶着路过，比起什么文化特色，更在意地砖滑不滑。下雨的早上，走到过街的地方都得放慢脚步。

en: Make Chinatown feel welcoming after dark, with lighting and small events. Just leave us a practical way to get deliveries in.
zh: 唐人街晚上可以弄得更有气氛，灯光好一点，办些小活动。不过也得给店家留条方便进货的路。

en: I come for the food and usually leave straight after. There's not much inviting me to stay, unless you count looking for dessert.
zh: 我一般就是来吃饭，吃完就走。没什么特别想留下来逛的，除非还要找点甜品。

en: A working drinking fountain would do me. Somewhere sheltered to refill my bottle without standing in a puddle would be even better.
zh: 有个能正常用的饮水台就挺好。接水时能遮雨、脚下又不用踩着积水，那就更好了。

en: The connection between the bus and train is useful, but waiting around isn't pleasant. When the seats are wet, everyone just stands.
zh: 公交换火车挺方便，就是等车时不太舒服。椅子一湿，大家只能站着。

en: Benches with backs, please. That's pretty much my wish list.
zh: 长椅请带靠背。我的要求基本就这些了。

en: Customers sometimes ask us where the toilets are. It's awkward when the answer isn't simple, especially for someone with a wheelchair or kids.
zh: 客人有时会问厕所在哪儿，没法简单指个方向，还挺尴尬的。碰上坐轮椅或者带孩子的，就更不好解释。

en: I'm not sold on night markets. We already clean up enough mess. Try daytime activities and sort drainage before adding more crowds.
zh: 夜市这事我不太看好，现在要收拾的垃圾就够多了。不如先办点白天的活动，把排水弄好，再考虑吸引更多人。

en: Some evenings feel lively, others feel a bit deserted. I still like walking out for dinner. The wind can be surprisingly nasty though.
zh: 有的晚上挺热闹，有的晚上又有点冷清。我还是喜欢走出去吃饭，不过这边有时风真挺大的。

en: I'd use it if there were shaded seats and room beside them for a wheelchair or pram. Please don't squeeze everything behind decorative steps.
zh: 有遮阴的座椅我就愿意去，旁边留点位置放婴儿车或停轮椅。别为了造型弄一圈台阶，把好用的地方都挡住。

en: Lunch can be busy, then it drops off. People ask about parking a lot. Also, the pigeons seem very happy with our outdoor tables.
zh: 午饭时忙一阵，过后就淡了。经常有人问哪儿能停车。还有，鸽子倒是特别喜欢我们外面的桌子。

en: I'd stay after a meal for a small night market, somewhere dry to sit and toilets I can find without asking a restaurant.
zh: 吃完饭要是有个小夜市，我愿意多待会儿。再有个干爽的地方坐，厕所也好找，不用跑进餐馆问就更好了。

en: It's handy living near everything, but the walk home feels patchy after dark. Bright shop windows, then suddenly a gloomy stretch.
zh: 住这儿去哪儿都方便，就是天黑回家的路上，有的地方亮，有的地方暗。刚走过灯火通明的店面，前面一下就黑了。

en: Proper lighting and somewhere to sit without feeling tucked out of sight. Please keep the trees, though. Floodlights everywhere would be horrible.
zh: 灯要照得清楚，座位也别放在看不见的角落。不过树还是要有，弄得到处都是刺眼的大灯也受不了。

en: I like the restaurants being busy. The shouting after they close, not so much. Some nights I just shut the windows.
zh: 餐馆热热闹闹的，我挺喜欢。就是打烊后外面的叫喊声有点烦，有些晚上只能关窗。

en: Night markets would get me downstairs instead of staying home. Keep them affordable and let the existing food shops join in.
zh: 有夜市的话，我就愿意下楼逛逛，不会老待在家。东西别太贵，也让原来的餐饮店一起参与。

en: We get people heading for trains, but they often hurry straight past. Deliveries are awkward already, especially when a car blocks the unloading spot.
zh: 赶火车的人不少，可大多匆匆走过去，不会停下来。现在送货已经挺麻烦了，卸货的地方再被车一堵，就更难办。

en: Keep some parking close by. Not everyone can carry groceries home, and a nice square won't change that.
zh: 附近还是得留点停车位。不是谁都能拎着一堆菜走回家，广场修得再漂亮也解决不了这个。

en: Mostly I'm watching the crossings and trying not to miss my bus. At night, some corners feel darker than they should.
zh: 平时就顾着过马路、赶公交。晚上有些转角实在太暗，走着不太踏实。

en: Give Chinatown a reason to linger: little food stalls, interesting signs and evening lights. Not just another paved space with expensive coffee.
zh: 唐人街得有点让人愿意多逛一会儿的东西，比如小吃摊、有特色的招牌和晚上的灯景。别又是铺块地，旁边卖贵咖啡。

en: It's convenient, just a bit messy between the buses and station. I follow the crowd more than the signs.
zh: 换乘挺方便，就是公交站和火车站之间有点乱。我基本跟着人流走，没怎么靠指示牌。

en: A clear walking route through the square, please. Don't make us weave around restaurant tables to catch a train.
zh: 请留一条穿过广场的通道，让人能顺顺当当地走。赶火车的时候，别还得绕来绕去躲餐桌。

en: Fine in daylight. After a late shift, I stick near whichever shops still have their lights on.
zh: 白天还好。下晚班回来，我就尽量贴着还亮着灯的店走。

en: Some cover from rain would help. Honestly, that's my main thing.
zh: 有个能挡雨的地方就好。说真的，我最在意的就是这个。

en: The food smells good when I'm rushing through. Usually no time to stop. The bus information is what annoys me most, honestly.
zh: 赶路经过时，闻着饭菜挺香，可惜一般没空停。说实话，我最烦的还是公交信息不够清楚。

en: Maybe small performances, but not amplified music all evening. I'd come for dinner and a relaxed wander, not a street nightclub.
zh: 可以有些小表演吧，但别整晚开着音响。我想来吃个饭、轻松逛逛，不是来露天蹦迪。

en: Evening trade can be good, but when the street goes quiet customers ask which way feels safest back to the station.
zh: 晚上的生意有时不错，可街上一冷清，客人就会问，回火车站走哪条路比较安全。

en: Show us where deliveries will go before changing the streets. Outdoor dining sounds good, but stock still has to reach the kitchen.
zh: 改街道之前，先说清楚以后在哪儿卸货。户外用餐是不错，可食材总得送进厨房吧。

en: That car park isn't pretty, but visiting family use it. I worry we're losing something practical for something that only looks good.
zh: 那个停车场是不好看，可家里人来看我都会停那儿。就怕把实用的东西拆了，换个只是好看的。

en: I'd happily lose the car park for shade and open space. Just don't fill the square with cafe seating you have to pay to use.
zh: 能换来树荫和公共空间，我愿意不要停车场。但别把广场都摆成咖啡店座位，想坐一下还得消费。

en: There are lovely places to eat, but not many comfortable spots to sit outside without buying anything. Summer afternoons feel especially harsh.
zh: 好吃的店不少，可在外面想找个不用花钱、坐着又舒服的地方，还真不容易。夏天下午尤其晒得难受。

en: Keep late events occasional. Better lighting, yes; booming speakers under nearby homes every weekend, absolutely not.
zh: 晚间活动偶尔办办就好。灯光改善我赞成，但每个周末都在住宅旁边放大音响，绝对不行。

en: Maybe it's just me, but the dark edges make it feel less welcoming than it really is. The shops themselves are friendly.
zh: 可能是我比较敏感，总觉得那些暗暗的边角让人不太敢走近。其实店里的人都挺友善的。

en: Public toilets that stay clean and open into the evening. Also bins. Sounds boring, but fancy paving won't help with those things.
zh: 公厕要干净，晚上也得开着。还有垃圾桶。这些听着没意思，但地砖铺得再漂亮也顶不了用。

en: I enjoy seeing people out eating after work. It feels safer when shops are open, though the delivery bikes can be a nuisance.
zh: 我喜欢下班后看街上有人吃饭、有点人气。店开着，走路也安心些，就是送餐的自行车有时候挺碍事。

en: Let nearby shops face onto the square and stay visible. Bright, active edges would reassure me more than cameras pointed at empty walls.
zh: 让周边店铺朝着广场开，别挡住门面。边上有灯、有店、有人，比对着空墙装摄像头更让我安心。

en: I come for dinner, then usually leave. Not sure where I'd hang around afterwards, and finding the way back can be confusing.
zh: 我一般过来吃完饭就走。吃完也不知道还能去哪儿待着，有时候回去的路也不太好找。

en: Keep some public parking in the replacement building. A nice square won't help much if bringing groceries home becomes a headache.
zh: 新楼里还是留点公共停车位吧。广场再漂亮，要是买完菜回家都费劲，也没多大用。

en: It's handy for food and trains, but some stretches feel gloomy after dinner. I tend to take the longer, brighter way home.
zh: 吃饭、坐火车都方便，就是晚饭后有些路段暗暗的。我回家宁愿绕点路，走亮堂些的地方。

en: Get rid of the car park, honestly. Give us proper trees and somewhere to sit that isn't beside a driveway.
zh: 说真的，把停车场拆了吧。种些能遮阴的树，弄点座位，别让人坐在车道旁边就行。

en: Mostly I just hurry through to the station. Crossing near turning cars is the annoying bit, especially when everyone's rushing.
zh: 我基本就是赶着去车站。最烦过马路时还得躲转弯的车，大家赶时间的时候尤其乱。

en: A clear, well-lit route between the buses and station. Please don't put planters right across where people naturally walk.
zh: 公交站和火车站之间的路要好认、灯光要足。别在人最顺脚的通道上摆花槽挡路。

en: Fine in daylight. Waiting for a bus after a late shift feels a bit lonely, though I'm not sure a square changes that.
zh: 白天还行。下晚班等公交时，周围冷冷清清的，不过建个广场能不能改善，我也说不准。

en: Night markets would bring me back, especially food stalls and small performances. Not another empty paved area with a fancy sign.
zh: 有夜市我会常来，尤其是小吃摊和小型表演。别又弄成一大片空地，最后只有个好看的招牌。

en: The parking entrance interrupts the walk to my bus. Drivers are looking for spaces, pedestrians are looking at phones. Not a great mix.
zh: 去坐公交要经过停车场出入口，走起来不顺。司机忙着找车位，行人又盯着手机，凑一起挺让人担心的。

en: Somewhere dry to wait would do me. And lighting that actually reaches the footpaths, not just decorative lights overhead.
zh: 对我来说，有个能避雨等车的地方就不错。灯也得真正照亮人行道，别光顾着挂好看的装饰灯。

en: I'm usually half asleep passing through. Coffee options are good; figuring out which way to the bus can be surprisingly confusing.
zh: 我经过这里时通常还没睡醒。买咖啡倒方便，就是找去公交站的方向，有时还真有点绕。

en: Don't remove customer parking without a practical replacement. We also need somewhere deliveries can stop without blocking the new pedestrian areas.
zh: 别把顾客停车位撤了，却没个靠谱的替代方案。送货车也得有地方停，不能到时候堵着新的步行区。

en: People eat and leave rather than linger around our end. The car park takes up space, but some customers definitely rely on it.
zh: 我们这头的人大多吃完就走，不太会多逛。停车场是占地方，可也确实有顾客靠它停车。

en: I'd rather have people walking past the shop than cars sitting there. Give Chinatown room for food events, with decent rubbish collection afterwards.
zh: 比起停着一堆车，我更想看到有人从店门口走过。让唐人街能办美食活动，办完也要及时清垃圾。

en: Closing up can feel uncomfortable when the street gets quiet. A few dark corners make the whole walk to the car feel longer.
zh: 打烊后街上静下来，有时心里会不踏实。几个黑乎乎的角落，就让走去停车的那段路显得特别长。

en: Public toilets, shade and somewhere to eat takeaway. Honestly, those matter more to me than whatever the new building looks like.
zh: 有公厕、有树荫，还有能坐着吃外卖的地方。说实话，这些比新楼盖得什么样更要紧。
